Businessman's Wife Arrested in Extortion Case Involving Gogi Gang

A businessman's wife, Sapan Jain, has been arrested in connection with an extortion case involving the Gogi gang. The Delhi police special cell has revealed a conspiracy to extort 50 lakh rupees from the businessman. The investigation is ongoing.
